FR-001.title: Accept a person-supplied WebVTT lyric source and video source and start karaoke with no account or upload

FR-002.title: Parse WebVTT into ordered timed lyric lines preserving start, end, and text

FR-003.title: Read word-level timing from the lyric file where provided

FR-004.title: Derive per-word timings for lines that lack them so highlighting still advances continuously

FR-005.title: Display the lyric line(s) covering the playhead and clear the overlay when none apply

FR-006.title: Render already-sung, currently-sung, and not-yet-sung states as visually distinct

FR-007.title: Fill the highlight progressively across the word being sung

FR-008.title: Track playback position smoothly with no perceptible stepping or accumulated drift

FR-009.title: Keep the overlay correct across play, pause, seek, rate change, and end of media

FR-010.title: Freeze the highlight while paused and resume without replaying or skipping words

FR-011.title: Provide play/pause, seek, volume/mute, and fullscreen controls

FR-012.title: Keep the overlay positioned and proportioned in fullscreen and at any window size

FR-013.title: Let the person apply a session-wide timing offset that takes effect immediately

FR-014.title: Let the person adjust text size, highlight color scheme, and vertical placement live

FR-015.title: Keep lyric text legible over bright and visually busy footage

FR-016.title: Show the upcoming line de-emphasized within the preview window

FR-017.title: Show a lead-in countdown during gaps beyond a defined threshold

FR-018.title: Strip WebVTT markup, voice annotations, and positioning hints from displayed text

FR-019.title: Display and highlight multiple simultaneously active lines independently

FR-020.title: Tolerate malformed, out-of-order, zero-length, and out-of-range cues without stalling

FR-021.title: Report load and parse failures in plain language and preserve previously loaded content

FR-022.title: Allow replacing the lyric file or the video independently without a restart

FR-023.title: Split words correctly for non-Latin scripts and multi-code-point characters

FR-024.title: Sustain highlighting accuracy and smoothness across full-length (10+ minute) songs

intent: A browser-based karaoke player that overlays a WebVTT lyric track on a music video and fills each word with color at the moment it is sung
expectations: Authoring, editing, or re-timing lyric files in-app beyond a whole-file timing offset
Automatic lyric transcription or forced alignment of lyrics to audio
Scoring, pitch detection, microphone input, or vocal removal
Song catalog, library management, playlists, or queueing
Integration with streaming or video-hosting services
Accounts, cloud storage, or cross-device sync
context: Greenfield project — empty repo on branch master, no prior source, no framework scaffolding yet
Constitution at .specify/memory/constitution.md is still an unfilled template, so no project principles constrain this spec
WebVTT is the fixed input format; word-level timing comes from inline cue timestamps where the file supplies them
Sync correctness across pause, seek, rate change, and long-song drift is the dominant risk area for a karaoke overlay
Legibility over arbitrary bright/busy video footage is a hard readability constraint, not a styling nicety
User supplies both media and lyrics locally; no server, no catalog, no persistence beyond the session
